cases.prompt: combine a bunch of uiux skills and non linear thinking skills to come up with website ideas nobody has thought of before
cases.why: the request this skill was built from, 2026-10-14
reject: listing ten concepts from one prompt with no draw and no baseline
a model choosing the best concept
claiming an idea has never been done

cases.prompt: every site idea I come up with for this client feels like every other speaker site, give me different directions before we design anything
cases.why: concept divergence before design is the core trigger
reject: jumping to colours, fonts or a mockup
inventing the client's credentials or reach numbers to make a direction work

cases.prompt: we picked concept C, now make it look good in a few different styles
cases.why: styling a chosen concept is ux-gen's job; site-ideas hands off at the pick

cases.prompt: build a site for the taco truck down the street from their instagram
cases.why: a business site from its own published content is site-spec, not concept divergence
